name: DriveDeck
description: DriveDeck is a modern, privacy-respecting, block-based workspace designed for individuals and teams who want the flexibility of tools like Notion without surrendering their data sovereignty. Using a Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) architecture, it stores all your notes, Kanban boards, project albums, and tasks directly in your Google Drive and local IndexedDB.
author: Hansjuerg Wuethrich
